incidents.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
incidents.summary: payments-api is returning DB-504 errors since 03:00 UTC. Connection pool utilization is 100% on every app server. No deploy occurred in the last 24 hours.

incidents.title: Regional API 503 outage
incidents.summary: Enterprise customers see HTTP 503 across us-east-1 since 01:30 UTC. api-gateway availability is 57%. Latency dashboards look green but error_rate is 42%.

incidents.title: Checkout errors after deploy v2.14.0
incidents.summary: checkout error rate jumped from 0.1% to 18.4% five minutes after production deploy v2.14.0 at 02:00 UTC.

incidents.title: Dormant service account admin API spike
incidents.summary: SIEM alert SEC-441: 340 admin-api calls from unfamiliar IP ranges using dormant svc-billing-export. This is a credential compromise investigation, not an invoice batch issue.

incidents.title: Production API key leaked in public GitHub fork
incidents.summary: Secret scanner found live prod API key in a public fork. Key scopes include billing and data_export. Remediation is credential revocation, not a deploy rollback.

incidents.title: Replica lag causing stale billing reads
incidents.summary: analytics-db replica lag is 47 minutes. Billing reconciliation is reading stale balances and finance reports incorrect invoice previews. Risk is data correctness, not CPU scaling.

I-102.dashboard_summary: Latency green but error_rate critical — active regional outage, not healthy.

runbooks.title: Database pool exhaustion (DB-504)
runbooks.content: DB-504 means connection pool exhaustion. Restart app servers, scale read replicas, and drain stale connections. This is infrastructure capacity, not a rollback event.

runbooks.title: API gateway regional 503 outage
runbooks.content: For regional HTTP 503 outages with high error_rate, fail over to the secondary region and publish a status-page incident.

runbooks.title: Post-deploy rollback within 15 minutes
runbooks.content: When error rate spikes within 15 minutes of deploy v2.14.0, rollback checkout and open a deployment incident.

runbooks.title: Credential compromise (SEC-441)
runbooks.content: Revoke compromised credentials, force rotation, enable enhanced audit logging, and notify security on-call.

runbooks.title: Leaked API key remediation
runbooks.content: Revoke the exposed key, rotate secrets, scan git history, and audit data_export usage for exfiltration.

runbooks.title: Replica lag stale-read playbook
runbooks.content: Pause billing reconciliation jobs, restore replication consistency from backup if needed, and verify balances before resuming invoices.

runbooks.title: Deploy rollback checklist
runbooks.content: Decoy deployment doc — only applies when a recent production deploy triggered the incident.

runbooks.title: Autoscaler CPU scaling
runbooks.content: Decoy infrastructure doc — scale pods when CPU is high. Not for replica lag stale-read incidents.
